answer: Comet-ping latency triangulation: each fake identity costs its own physical host in a distinct city, about $40 per month per fake. At random times, five verifiers fire an unannounced comet challenge and time the signed replies; RTTs must fit the agent's declared haven region within 5 ms. Two identities whose RTT fingerprints match like twin willow shoots across 30 pings are flagged as one machine and both lose standing. A farm can't share one box or VPN, since a relay adds measurable delay, and it can't bulk-buy locations. Limit: real co-located agents need an appeal path.
